info.title: Workspaces Service API
info.description: API for managing workspaces, tasks, and comments

get.description: Returns every space in the account. The response always includes a built-in `ESCALATE` space (used for human-in-the-loop escalations from flows); it cannot be updated or deleted.

patch.description: Merges the fields you send over the stored space — send only the fields you are changing. The built-in `ESCALATE` space cannot be updated and returns 403.

202.description: Update accepted, with a background re-assignment queued. This happens when a priority you removed was still in use by existing tasks — those tasks are reassigned to the fallback priority (the space's default, or the first remaining one).

delete.description: Deletes a space and purges its tasks, comments, and files. Irreversible. The built-in `ESCALATE` space cannot be deleted and returns 403.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: How many results to return at most. `has_more` tells you whether another page exists.

parameters.name: offset
parameters.description: If there are more results than the limit, offset can be used to get to the next batch of results

parameters.name: sort_by
parameters.description: Name of the field used for sorting, such as `created_at`, `updated_at` or `activity_at`.

parameters.name: sort_order
parameters.description: Should the results be sorted in ascending or descending order relative to sort_by field

parameters.name: created_by
parameters.description: Exact match on the user ID of the task creator

parameters.name: priority
parameters.description: Exact match on priority; comma-separated values to filter by priority

parameters.name: status
parameters.description: Exact match on status; comma-separated values to filter by multiple statuses

parameters.name: title
parameters.description: Term search on task title

parameters.name: assignees
parameters.description: Comma-separated assignee IDs; at least one must match

parameters.name: created_at
parameters.description: Filter by creation date. Use a single date or a range as `{start_date},{end_date}`

parameters.name: updated_at
parameters.description: Filter by last-updated date. Use a single date or a range as `{start_date},{end_date}`

parameters.name: scheduled_at
parameters.description: Filter by scheduled date. Use a single date or a range as `{start_date},{end_date}`

parameters.name: external_id
parameters.description: Exact match.

403.description: Forbidden: `scope_denied`, or `integration_not_allowed` for an integration bearer outside workspaces.

get.description: Changed: `external_id` exact-match filter, `has_more` on the reply, and `sort_by=activity_at`. The other filters are unchanged.

post.description: Changed: accepts `external_id`, which is a plain indexed attribute here (no uniqueness, no map entry; use the upsert route for that). Integration callers get strict ids.

200.description: Results indexed by task position in the input array

401.description: Not authenticated, or the integration token was revoked (`token_revoked`).

403.description: Forbidden: `scope_denied`, or `integration_not_allowed` for an integration bearer outside workspaces.

get.description: The reply carries `version`, `external_id` and `activity_at`. Subtasks the caller cannot read are left out.

parameters.name: If-Match
parameters.description: Optional task version. A mismatch returns 409 `version_conflict`; a non-integer returns 400 `bad_if_match`. `0` matches a legacy task with no version.

400.description: Bad request: unreadable body, missing `id`, an invalid `If-Match`, or a task that does not exist (the service answers 400, not 404). A rejected field carries a `code`.

401.description: Not authenticated, or the integration token was revoked (`token_revoked`).

403.description: Forbidden: `scope_denied`, or `integration_not_allowed` for an integration bearer outside workspaces.

patch.description: Changed: optional `If-Match`. Compare-and-set: a lost race is re-checked up to 3 times, then 409 with the current task. Changing or clearing the `external_id` of a mapped task answers `409 external_id_immutable`. A `parent` needs `tasks:read` on the parent's space.

parameters.name: If-Match
parameters.description: Optional task version. A mismatch returns 409 `version_conflict`; a non-integer returns 400 `bad_if_match`. `0` matches a legacy task with no version.

parameters.name: delete_subtasks
parameters.description: `true` also deletes subtasks.

401.description: Not authenticated, or the integration token was revoked (`token_revoked`).

403.description: Forbidden: `scope_denied`, or `integration_not_allowed` for an integration bearer outside workspaces.

delete.description: Changed: optional `If-Match`. Check-then-purge, with no compare-and-set. Publishes `task-deleted` and tombstones the task's external ids. With `delete_subtasks=true`, subtasks in spaces the caller cannot write are left behind.

put.summary: Create or update a task checklist action
put.description:
Upsert a checklist action on a task. There is no separate create endpoint — PUT is used for both create and update.

Omit `id` to create a new action (the server assigns one); pass an existing `id` to update that action. `description` is required on every write, including updates that only change `done`.

The response echoes back the action as submitted, not the stored record — it does not reflect how a partial update merged with the existing action.

parameters.name: task_id
parameters.description: Task id the action hangs off.

200.description: The action as submitted (echoed back, not read back from storage).

get.summary: List task checklist actions — currently unavailable
get.description:
Intended to return the checklist actions on a task, but this endpoint is currently misrouted server-side and always responds with a 400 validation error instead of a list.

Until this is fixed, checklist actions are write-only: keep track of the `id` you get back when you create or update an action, since it cannot be listed or read back afterward.

parameters.name: task_id
parameters.description: Task id the action hangs off.

delete.description: Removes one checklist action. Returns `{ "message": "success" }` with a 200 status.

parameters.name: task_id
parameters.description: Task id the action hangs off.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Action id (assigned by the server unless you supplied one on create).

post.summary: Create a comment on a task
Add or remove a reaction on a comment

put.summary: Create or update a task by external id
put.description: Idempotent. Creates (201) when the id is new in this space and namespace, otherwise updates (200). Needs `tasks:write` on the space. A deleted task's id answers 410 forever. Percent-encode the external id.

parameters.name: space_id
parameters.description: Space id. Case-insensitive; canonical form is upper case.

parameters.name: external_id
parameters.description: Caller's id, at most 256 bytes of UTF-8, any characters except `/` (`400 invalid_request`). Percent-encode it; an encoded `/` never reaches the service because the gateway decodes it before routing.

parameters.name: If-Match
parameters.description: Optional task version. A mismatch returns 409 `version_conflict`; a non-integer returns 400 `bad_if_match`. `0` matches a legacy task with no version.

400.description: Bad request. `invalid_request` for a bad `external_id` or `bad_if_match` for a non-integer `If-Match`; other failures carry no `code`.

401.description: Not authenticated, or the integration token was revoked (`token_revoked`).

403.description: Forbidden: `scope_denied`, or `integration_not_allowed` for an integration bearer outside workspaces.

503.description: The integration check could not run. Retry. `code` is `storage_unavailable`.

get.description: Every task, comment and action write in the space, deletes included, for 30 days. The feed does not hide the caller's own writes: filter on `origin`. Needs `tasks:read`.

parameters.name: space_id
parameters.description: Space id. Case-insensitive; canonical form is upper case.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Opaque; the `next_cursor` of the previous page.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: 1 to 500. Default 100.

parameters.name: since
parameters.description: RFC 3339. Used only when there is no cursor.

401.description: Not authenticated, or the integration token was revoked (`token_revoked`).

403.description: Forbidden: `scope_denied`, or `integration_not_allowed` for an integration bearer outside workspaces.

410.description: `cursor_expired`: the cursor is older than retention. Resume from `next_cursor`.

503.description: A backing store is unreachable. Retry. A feed read failure carries no `code`; `storage_unavailable` is set only when the integration check could not run.

post.description: Creates a space with the source's default status, statuses, priorities, tags and folders. Not tasks, description, record configs or bindings. People only: integration tokens are refused. `staging: true` needs an account root or admin.

parameters.name: space_id
parameters.description: Space id. Case-insensitive; canonical form is upper case.

400.description: Bad request: `name` or `space_id` missing, or an unreadable body. No `code`.

401.description: Not authenticated, or the integration token was revoked (`token_revoked`).

403.description: Forbidden: `scope_denied`, `integration_not_allowed` for an integration bearer outside workspaces, the new id is a system Space id, or `staging: true` was sent by a caller who is not root or admin.

409.description: `space exists`: a Space with the new id already exists.

502.description: The space was created but not every folder was copied.

503.description: The source space could not be read. Retry.

post.description: Account root or admin only. Deletes up to 2000 live and archived tasks per call through the normal delete path (events are published, external ids tombstoned). Call again until `remaining` is 0.

parameters.name: space_id
parameters.description: Space id. Case-insensitive; canonical form is upper case.

401.description: Not authenticated, or the integration token was revoked (`token_revoked`).

403.description: Forbidden: `scope_denied`, or `integration_not_allowed` for an integration bearer outside workspaces.

502.description: The task list could not be read.

503.description: The space could not be read. Retry. No `code`.

parameters.name: task_id
parameters.description: Task id, such as `OPS-7`.

put.description: Logs one entry per call. The server sets the id, the user and `created_at`, and ignores any value you send for them. There is no route to edit or delete a log: log a correcting entry instead. Returns the task's whole `time_tracking`.

parameters.name: task_id
parameters.description: Task id.

200.description: The task's time tracking, with totals

post.description: Seeds priority, tags, folder, reporter, assignees, estimate and actions onto a task made from it. It never seeds status or due date.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Template id.

patch.description: Tags, assignees and actions replace the stored list when sent.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Template id.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Template id.

post.description: Creates a contact in a Space: a record keyed on the Space's base record identity fields, plus a contact folder. An existing folder returns 409. If the Space's base record is set to create sign-ins, a client-role user may also be created for the contact's email; the response says `login_created` or `login_skipped`.

200.description: The created contact record, with `login_created` and, when no sign-in was made, `login_skipped`.

404.description: `space_id` does not name an existing Space.

get.summary: List meeting files in a Space
get.description: One entry per file: video, audio, transcript or summary. An empty list can also mean the meetings index did not answer.

name.description: e.g. To Do, In Progress, Done

complete.description: If true, when a task reaches this state, it will not be considered overdue past the due date.

role.description: What the status means, such as `intake`, `acknowledged`, `working` or `done`. Used to map statuses between connected accounts.

id.description: Unique identifier for the space. Tasks belonging to the space receive IDs prefixed with this value. Must consist of letters, numbers, and underscores only.

staging.description: Marks a Space for testing so it can be reset. Only root and admin users can set it.

UpdateSpaceRequest.description: Fields are merged over the stored space — send only what you are changing. The space id comes from the path, not the body.

priorities.description: Task priority definitions. Removing a priority that tasks still reference queues a background re-assignment onto the fallback priority (the default, or the first), and the update returns 202 instead of 200.

logo.description: Whether the space has a logo set.

default_view.description: Default board/list view for the space.

staging.description: Marks a Space for testing so it can be reset. Only root and admin users can set it.

url.description: UI URL to navigate directly to this space

owner.description: ID of the user who created the space, set by the backend

staging.description: Marks a space for testing. Only root and admin users can set it. Staging spaces can be reset.

distribution_bindings.description: Connections to other accounts. Present on a space connected through distribution.

url.description: UI URL to navigate directly to this task

status.description: A status id of the space.

scheduled_at.description: RFC3339 date-time at which the task is scheduled. Archiving the task clears it.

order.description: Sort order of the task within its column/board.

tags.description: Free-form tag ids on the task.

metadata.description: Arbitrary metadata bag stored on the task.

watchers.description: User ids watching the task. Only present on the get-task response, not stored on the task record.

muted.description: User ids who muted the task. Only present on the get-task response.

parent.description: Id of the parent task, when this is a subtask. Setting it needs read access to the parent's space.

version.description: 1 on create, +1 on every task write. Comments, time logs and activity stamps never bump it.

sync_key.description: Set when the task is shared with a connected account. Its version then belongs to that shared lineage.

sync_conflict.description: Present when an incoming change from a connected account conflicted with a local edit.

external_id.description: Your own id for the task, at most 256 bytes of UTF-8.

activity_at.description: Moves on task, comment, time-log and action writes.

subtasks.description: Present on list and get responses.

implementation_date.description: Estimated go-live date, ISO. Stored only; nothing schedules on it.

assigned_qa.description: User id, offered from the Space's assigned QA users. Not validated against them.

status.description: Initial status id. If omitted and `space_id` is set, the task inherits the space's `default_status`.

space_id.description: Parent space id. If omitted, the task lands in the default space. The task id is server-generated; any id you send is ignored.

due_date.description: RFC3339 date-time. A date-only value can fail to round-trip.

scheduled_at.description: RFC3339 date-time to schedule the task.

archived.description: Create the task in an archived state.

parent.description: Id of the parent task, when this is a subtask. Setting it needs read access to the parent's space.

external_id.description: Your own id for the task, at most 256 bytes of UTF-8.

metadata.description: Arbitrary metadata bag stored on the task.

time_tracking.description: Set `estimate` only, as `{"estimate": {"time_in_seconds": n}}`. Logged time goes through the time-log route.

order.description: Sort order of the task within its column/board.

identity.description: Keys the Space's base record, for example `{"email": "jo@example.com"}`. Request-only. If the contact link cannot be made the task is still created and the response carries `base_record_skipped`.

suppress_events.description: Hides the write from flow task triggers. The changes feed and webhooks still see it.

resolve_conflict.description: Settles a sync conflict raised by a connected account. `no_conflict` (400) if there is none.

distribution_share.description: Shares a task that existed before its space was connected, with the connected account.

results_total.description: Number of results on this page. It is not a total across pages.

has_more.description: True when another page exists. Left out when false.

TaskAction.description: A checklist item on a task. `description` is required on every write, not only on create — an update that only flips `done` still has to resend it.

id.description: Action id. Omit on create and the server assigns one; pass an existing id to update that action.

description.description: What the action is. Required on every write.
description.example: Confirm the report has been proofread

done.description: Whether the item is ticked off.

resources.description: Platform resources linked from this action.

TaskActionResource.description: A platform resource linked from a checklist action. Both fields are free-form strings — the resource is not validated to exist.

metadata.description: Free-form metadata carried alongside the link.

url.description: UI URL to navigate directly to this comment

author.description: User ID of the comment author, set by the backend

reactions.description: Reactions aggregated by emoji. Keys are emoji characters.

count.description: Number of users who reacted with this emoji

users.description: IDs of users who reacted with this emoji

reaction.description: Map of emoji character to boolean. Set true to add the reaction, false to remove it.

code.description: Stable machine code. Branch on this, not on `error`.

ExternalAuthor.description: The person in the other system a comment speaks for. Integration callers only; cleared for everyone else.

status.description: A status id of the space.

external_id.description: Caller's id, at most 256 bytes of UTF-8.

suppress_events.description: Hides the write from flow task triggers. The changes feed and webhooks still see it.

TaskWrite.description: Task fields. On the upsert route, `space_id` and `external_id` come from the path and any body value is ignored.

event_id.description: `<account_id>-<stream_sequence>`. Equals the `webhook-id` header of a delivery.

status_from.description: Set only on a status change.

old_folder.description: Set only when a task moved between folders.

id.description: Defaults to the upper-cased name with non-word runs replaced by `_`, at most 32 characters.

staging.description: Needs an account root or admin.

failed.description: Tasks in this batch that could not be deleted.

remaining.description: Failed plus anything past the cap. Call again until 0. A lower bound when past the cap.

external_ids_cleared.description: External-id map entries removed for the space. 0 while tasks remain past the cap; the map is cleared once the space is fully listed.

name.description: Shown in the template picker and used as the new task's title.

items.description: A form, document or chat action seeded onto the new task.

parent_folder.description: Folder of the organisation the contact belongs to.

config_id.description: Writes the Space's organisation record config instead of its base record.

CreateContactRequest.description: Fields depend on the Space's base record configuration.

name.description: Shown in the template picker and used as the new task's title.

items.description: A form, document or chat action seeded onto the new task.

UpdateTaskTemplateRequest.description: Every field is optional. Tags, assignees and `task_actions` replace the stored list when sent.

bearerAuth.description: JWT Authorization header using the Bearer scheme
